name: cerebras
description: Fast OpenAI-compatible chat and text completions with Cerebras Inference
long_description: Bring a Cerebras Inference API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key lists models (GET /v1/models), which runs no inference and costs nothing; it does not check your credit balance or rate limits. A Sprite can then list and read models and create chat completions and text completions, including SSE streaming. Completions are charged per token to your Cerebras account. Batch jobs, file uploads and deletes, Dedicated Inference model and endpoint management, metrics, API keys, projects, billing and team management are not forwarded.

notes: Set stream to true for SSE. Keep max_completion_tokens near what you need: Cerebras counts it against your token rate limit before the request runs, and the gateway waits 120 seconds for response headers.

json.prompt: Fast inference matters for agents because

messages.402: Cerebras credits exhausted or expired; add credits in the Cerebras Cloud console
messages.404: Cerebras model not found or not available to this key; check GET /v1/models
messages.429: Cerebras rate limit reached (requests or tokens per minute); retry later or lower max_completion_tokens
messages.503: Cerebras Inference is temporarily unavailable; retry later

presentation.tagline: Fast OpenAI-compatible inference from a Sprite without putting your Cerebras key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at cloud.cerebras.ai, open API Keys in the left nav (on paid accounts, pick a project first) and click Generate API Key. Copy the key and paste it here. New accounts get $5 of trial credits after adding a payment method.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving, replacing or testing the key calls `GET /v1/models`, which runs no inference and costs nothing. It does not check your credit balance. Chat and text completions are charged per input and output token to your Cerebras account, at the model's price (for example $0.35 per million input tokens and $0.75 per million output tokens for `gpt-oss-120b`). Reading models is free. Trial credits expire 30 days after they are granted, and Cerebras answers 402 when credits run out.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/models/:model_id`, `POST /v1/chat/completions` and `POST /v1/completions` are forwarded. Completions can stream with SSE. Batch jobs, files, Dedicated Inference management and metrics, API keys, projects, billing and team management are not forwarded. Rate limits apply per organization and model, in requests and tokens per minute.

usage_notes: Errors are `{"message": "...", "type": "...", "param": "...", "code": "..."}`; a wrong key is 401 with `code: wrong_api_key`. A 429 message says whether the uncached or total token limit was hit.
Cerebras estimates each request's tokens from the prompt plus `max_completion_tokens` and rate-limits on that estimate before it runs, so set `max_completion_tokens` to what you need.
Request headers such as `X-Cerebras-Version-Patch` and `queue_threshold` are not forwarded; requests get Cerebras's default API version.
